attribution: Wiktionary contributors; extracted via Kaikki.org; SQLite dataset provided by Lector.
upstream_processing_notice: The source dataset was extracted from Wiktionary via Kaikki.org and packaged as a lookup database by Lector.
conversion_notice: The original SQLite dataset was converted into partitioned JSON files for application lookup. Dictionary content was preserved.
index_notice: Extracted entry words into a separate sorted autocomplete index. Definitions and original dictionary partitions were not changed.
ordering: Unicode code point order; original spelling preserved. JavaScript default string sort uses a different order for supplementary characters.
routing: FNV-1a 32-bit over exact UTF-8 key bytes; hash & 1023
scope: All entries table words; excludes keys present only in other tables. Includes inflected entry words. No meanings or grammatical metadata.
